card_banking-system_desc.source: Built a C++ banking system on Linux that grew over the semester from a single-machine program into a distributed one. Started with processes talking through pipes, moved to a client-server setup, then added a thread pool so the server could handle many requests at once. Finished by connecting clients and servers across machines over TCP/IP sockets.
card_banking-system_desc.text: 在 Linux 上构建了一个 C++ 银行系统，这个系统在一个学期内从单机程序发展成分布式程序。最初是通过管道通信的进程，后来发展成客户端-服务器架构，然后添加了线程池，让服务器能同时处理大量请求。最后通过 TCP/IP 套接字连接客户端和服务器，跨机器连接。

card_pearl-tea_desc.source: Built a boba shop POS system with a team, starting as a JavaFX desktop app with customer and manager views for 120+ menu items, backed by a PostgreSQL database on AWS. Then moved it to the web with Node.js/Express APIs and led deployment on Render with secure authentication. Added multi-layer caching that cut API calls per page load by more than half, plus text-to-speech and weather-based drink recommendations for accessibility.
card_pearl-tea_desc.text: 和团队一起构建了一个珍珠奶茶店 POS 系统，最初是一个带有 120+ 菜单项的客户和经理视图的 JavaFX 桌面应用，并由 AWS 上的 PostgreSQL 数据库支撑。随后将其迁移到网页，使用 Node.js/Express API，并带领了带安全认证的 Render 部署。增加了多层缓存，使每页加载的 API 调用减少了一半以上，同时还提供了基于文本转语音和天气的饮料推荐，以提升无障碍性。

card_multi-agent-deploy_desc.source: Built a team of five AI agents with the Claude API that set up and manage a cloud deployment on AWS (S3, CloudFront, CodePipeline, CodeBuild). Each agent only gets the tools it needs, and risky changes wait for a human to approve them. Every push to GitHub runs 39 site tests, publishes a new release behind CloudFront, and runs 10 live checks, automatically rolling back to the last working release if anything fails. When something breaks, a diagnostician agent traces the cause and proposes a fix.
card_multi-agent-deploy_desc.text: 组建了一支由五名 AI 代理组成的团队，使用 Claude API，在 AWS 上搭建和管理云部署（S3、CloudFront、CodePipeline、CodeBuild）。每个代理只获得所需的工具，风险变更需人工批准。每次推送到 GitHub 都会运行 39 项网站测试，在 CloudFront 后面发布新版本，并运行 10 项实时检查，如果出现故障会自动回滚到最后一个可用的版本。当某项系统出现故障时，诊断代理会追踪原因并提出修复方案。

card_real-estate-deal_desc.source: Built a multi-agent AI tool with a five-person team that screens commercial real estate deals and writes investment memos. Instead of relying on what the model remembers, it pulls every number from the uploaded deal documents, cites where it came from, and flags missing data rather than guessing. Added guardrails that keep it on topic and double-check its answers, which blocked all five prompt-injection and off-topic attempts in testing.
card_real-estate-deal_desc.text: 与五人团队一起构建了一个多代理 AI 工具，用于筛选商业地产交易并撰写投资备忘录。它不再依赖模型记忆，而是从上传的交易文件中提取所有数字，标明数据来源，并标记缺失数据而非猜测。增加了防护栏，确保其聚焦主题并再次核对答案，这阻止了测试中所有五次提示注入和偏离主题的尝试。

card_imdb-sentiment_desc.source: Built and compared two PyTorch models that read IMDB movie reviews and decide whether they're positive or negative: a Transformer encoder and an LSTM. Wrote the pipeline around them myself, including text cleaning, a 10,000-word vocabulary, a classification token, attention masks that skip padding, and sinusoidal positional encoding. Trained both with dropout, weight decay, and a cosine learning rate schedule, reaching 82.4% test accuracy with the Transformer and 82.1% with the LSTM.
card_imdb-sentiment_desc.text: 构建并比较了两个 PyTorch 模型，用于读取 IMDB 电影评论并判断其为正面还是负面：一个 Transformer 编码器和一个 LSTM。自己编写了模型外围的完整流程，包括文本清理、一万词的词汇表、分类标记、跳过填充的注意力掩码以及正弦位置编码。使用 Dropout、权重衰减和余弦学习率调度训练两个模型，Transformer 的测试准确率达到 82.4%，LSTM 达到 82.1%。

card_scene-cnn_desc.source: Built a convolutional neural network in PyTorch that looks at a photo and decides whether it shows an airport terminal, bedroom, dining room, or living room, using images from the SUN397 scene dataset. Designed a four-layer network with batch normalization and dropout, and added random crops and flips during training so it learns from more varied examples. It reached 76.4% accuracy on held-out test photos, with living rooms being the easiest to mix up with bedrooms and dining rooms.
card_scene-cnn_desc.text: 在 PyTorch 中构建了一个卷积神经网络，根据照片判断照片显示的是机场航站楼、卧室、餐厅还是客厅，使用来自 SUN397 场景数据集的图像。设计了一个包含批量归一化和 Dropout 的四层网络，并在训练过程中添加了随机裁剪和翻转，以便从更多样化的实例中学习。在未参与训练的测试照片上，准确率达到了 76.4%，其中客厅与卧室、餐厅最容易混淆。

card_graphics-pipeline_desc.source: Built six graphics projects in C++, OpenGL, and GLSL for CSCE 441, each adding another piece of a 3D rendering pipeline. Started with a rasterizer written from scratch that fills in triangles and blends colors across them, then built a system for posing jointed 3D models. Wrote custom shaders for Blinn-Phong lighting, silhouettes, and cel shading, and added a free-look camera with a top-down map view. Built a deferred renderer that stores the scene in four textures and lights it with 10 moving colored lights, adds a screen-space blur, and shapes a surface of revolution on the GPU. Finished with a ray tracer that renders shadows, reflections, glass, and ambient occlusion.
card_graphics-pipeline_desc.text: 为 CSCE 441 编写了六个使用 C++、OpenGL 和 GLSL 的图形项目，每个项目都为 3D 渲染管线增添了一部分。最初从零编写了一个光栅化器，填充三角形并在三角形上混合颜色，然后构建了一个用于关节 3D 模型摆姿态的系统。为 Blinn-Phong 光影、剪影和赛璐璐渲染编写了自定义着色器，并添加了一个带有俯视地图视图的自由视角摄像机。构建了一个延迟渲染器，将场景存储为四张纹理，并用 10 个动态彩色灯光照明，添加屏幕空间模糊，并在 GPU 上塑造旋转曲面。最后构建了一个光线追踪器，可以渲染阴影、反射、玻璃和环境遮挡。

card_boston-regression_desc.source: Built and compared three regression models in R to predict median home values across Boston neighborhoods. Started with a single predictor, the share of lower-income residents, then added every available feature, raising the adjusted R² from 0.54 to 0.73. Checked the larger model for overlapping predictors using VIF, and used ANOVA to show that adding a curved term fit the data significantly better than a straight line.
card_boston-regression_desc.text: 在 R 中构建并比较了三个回归模型，以预测波士顿各社区的中位房价。从单一预测变量——低收入居民的比例开始，然后加入所有可用特征，将调整后的 R² 从 0.54 提高到 0.73。用 VIF 检查了更大模型中是否有重叠预测变量，并利用方差分析（ANOVA）显示，加入曲线项比直线显著更贴合数据。
